// Adds an IDIT chunk, the recording date as cameras write it, to an AVI
// made by ffmpeg: at the end of its hdrl list, whose size and the RIFF
// size grow by the chunk's.
//
// Usage: go run idit.go <in.avi> <out.avi> <date text>
package main

import (
	"encoding/binary"
	"os"
)

func main() {
	in, _ := os.ReadFile(os.Args[1])
	text := append([]byte(os.Args[3]), '\n', 0)
	if len(text)%2 == 1 {
		text = append(text, 0)
	}
	chunk := append(binary.LittleEndian.AppendUint32([]byte("IDIT"), uint32(len(text))), text...)
	// The first LIST is hdrl, at 12.
	if string(in[12:16]) != "LIST" || string(in[20:24]) != "hdrl" {
		panic("no hdrl at 12")
	}
	n := binary.LittleEndian.Uint32(in[16:])
	end := 20 + int(n)
	out := append(append(append([]byte(nil), in[:end]...), chunk...), in[end:]...)
	binary.LittleEndian.PutUint32(out[16:], n+uint32(len(chunk)))
	binary.LittleEndian.PutUint32(out[4:], binary.LittleEndian.Uint32(in[4:])+uint32(len(chunk)))
	if err := os.WriteFile(os.Args[2], out, 0o644); err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}
}
